finding.claim: Two places give the install steps in the wrong order. The plugin install/update help epilog and the overview's plugin install row both say kmctl removes the old hook and okf-bundle first, then runs apm uninstall on an old entry. install() runs remove_old_apm_entry first, as commands.md says. Also, doctor's claude.hook and claude.okf-mcp details still say 'the hook this kmctl writes' and 'not the one this kmctl writes', though APM writes both now.

fixes.change: The files checks read kmctl_files; claude.hook and claude.okf-mcp say kmctl's package ships or declares them.
The install help lists the old-entry uninstall before the removal of the old hook and okf-bundle, as the code runs them.
The plugin install row lists the steps in the code's order.
The sample claude.hook line matches doctor's new wording.

The fake lock lists the rules under kmctl-claude and kmctl-antigravity as real APM does; the real-install test checks that uninstall leaves no okf-bundle in either MCP file and no kmctl hook in .agents/hooks.json; expected messages updated.
